items.heading: A Company Secretary Helps Companies
items.text: A company secretary helps companies follow corporate law, run board meetings and keep records. Roles exist in listed firms, private companies, consultancies and independent practice.

items.heading: Check the Official Icsi Site
items.text: Check the official ICSI site for eligibility, syllabus, fees and attempts. Read ten notices from companies and consultancies for company secretary and compliance roles and note the experience asked.

items.text: Startups and small companies need compliance and governance support.
